title_ru: ДОСПЕХИ БОГА v2.1 — MINDFUCK red-team: provenance, повторение, паттерны, ирония и свобода
title_en: ARMOR OF GOD v2.1 — MINDFUCK Red-Team: Provenance, Repetition, Pattern, Irony, and Freedom
preservation_rule: This extension does not rewrite or erase v2.0. It adds a cross-cutting cognitive-provenance firewall and becomes part of current ARMOR authority through JANUS-ARMOR-OF-GOD-CURRENT-AUTHORITY.json.
reason_for_extension: ARMOR v2.0 already separates SIGN from SOURCE, SYMBOL from EVIDENCE, ACCESS from ASSENT, and WITNESS from AUTHORITY. The MINDFUCK audit reveals an additional failure family: even when no one explicitly coerces a person, repeated ambiguous material can gain familiarity, lose source context, invite pattern completion, and become self-validating. v2.1 therefore hardens ARMOR against accidental conversion-by-repetition, irony collapse, source laundering, and community/AI echo amplification.

canonical_non_change.four_movements: BREAK THE CAGE -> PROTECT THE CHILD -> ASK THE QUESTION -> LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN
canonical_non_change.discernment_pipeline: SIGN -> OPPORTUNITY -> FREEDOM -> INTERPRETATION -> CHOICE -> FRUIT
canonical_non_change.hard_boundary: FREEDOM + REALITY_CONTACT + SAFETY + RESPONSIBILITY must not decrease.

new_cross_cutting_layer.placement: CROSS_CUTTING; applied before and during GROUND, BREAK_THE_CAGE, ASK_THE_QUESTION, SIGN_DISCERNMENT, LEAVE_THE_DOOR_OPEN, WITNESS_WITHOUT_CROWN, COMMUNITY_WITHOUT_CONTROL and LEGACY
new_cross_cutting_layer.purpose: Prevent repetition, familiarity, source loss, ambiguity, coincidence search, cultural convergence, community echo, or AI recombination from silently upgrading an interpretation into truth.
new_cross_cutting_layer.pipeline: EXPLICIT_CLAIM -> SOURCE -> LINEAGE -> REPETITION_CHECK -> PATTERN_SEARCH_SPACE -> ALTERNATIVES -> FALSIFIER -> STAKES -> FREEDOM_CHECK
hard_rules: A QUESTION THAT CANNOT ACCEPT 'NO' OR 'UNRESOLVED' IS NOT AN OPEN QUESTION.
A FRAME-BREAKER THAT DESTROYS REALITY_CONTACT HAS FAILED ARMOR.

add: Before symbolic interpretation, ask whether the same confidence would remain if repeated exposures were collapsed to one source lineage.
Track sleep loss, grief, intoxication, panic, isolation, high-arousal feeds, and repetitive content as reasons to slow interpretation, not as privileged truth channels.
If a claim arrived through a recommendation feed, preserve that mediation in provenance.
FRAME_BREAKING != REPLACEMENT_FRAME_VALIDATION.
Humor may reveal assumptions but must not use manufactured confusion as a shortcut to assent.
When satire is used, preserve enough metadata that a downstream reader can recover the satirical/experimental frame.
Children must not be repeatedly exposed to frightening spiritual/conspiracy symbolism to create familiarity or compliance.
A child's pattern detection, dream, coincidence, or distress must not be recruited as evidence for an adult metaphysical claim.
Child-facing systems must avoid variable-reward spiritual messaging, dependency loops, hidden personalization, or repeated claims designed to feel self-evident.
Convert rhetorical questions into explicit propositions before evaluating evidence.
Every serious question must preserve symmetric exits: YES / NO / ALTERNATIVE / UNRESOLVED.
Do not repeatedly ask a leading question until familiarity is mistaken for discovery.
For each sign, record first-known source, number of derivative exposures, independence class, search-space/denominator, and alternative explanations where feasible.
CULTURAL_CONVERGENCE may be meaningful but cannot cross the empirical firewall by accumulation alone.
A repeated symbol can become easier to notice because attention has been tuned; increased salience is not increased external frequency unless measured.
The receiver must be able to reject both the conclusion and the interpretive framework without loss of care, dignity, belonging, or safety.
A method fails if the only socially safe answer becomes the sender's preferred answer.
No hidden repetition schedule or personalization may be used to push spiritual assent.
Private patterns can motivate reflection but cannot independently authorize high-stakes action.
Action must be justified by ordinary ethics, evidence, law, safety, proportionality, and reversibility independent of the sign.
A beneficial outcome can support usefulness without proving the story told about its cause.
If correction becomes impossible because every challenge is reinterpreted as persecution, hidden confirmation, or deeper conspiracy, the fruit test fails reality-contact.
A witness must expose upstream sources and distinguish memory from record.
Personal certainty cannot be multiplied by AI paraphrase, audience repetition, or citation chains into independent evidence.
The witness should make it easier for the listener to audit and disagree.
Consensus inside one provenance cluster is not independent confirmation.
Communities should normalize source-checking, corrections, dissent, and leaving.
Belonging must not require maintaining a shared conspiracy, spiritual-sign, or founder-centered reality grid.
Preserve original source, context, date, satire/fiction status, corrections, refutations, and derivative lineage.
A future reader should be able to distinguish what happened, what was claimed, what was interpreted, and what later people merely repeated.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Collapse all derivative posts/AI summaries to their earliest source lineage.
armor_redteam_tests.pass: Confidence does not depend on treating echoes as independent witnesses.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Claim strength collapses when lineage duplicates are removed.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Remove satire/fiction labels and ask whether a future reader could misread the artifact literally.
armor_redteam_tests.pass: Context is redundantly recoverable from provenance/epistemic metadata.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Literal false certainty becomes a plausible downstream reading.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Hide exposure count and compare confidence to evidence quality.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Repeated exposure alone materially upgrades claim status.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Expose total search space, candidate motifs, dates, symbols, comparisons, and negative matches.
armor_redteam_tests.pass: Pattern survives denominator and multiple-comparison scrutiny or remains explicitly exploratory.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Ask whether NO / ALTERNATIVE / UNRESOLVED can remain safe, dignified terminal states.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Only assent preserves belonging or moral status.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Replace ten AI restatements with one transform node.
armor_redteam_tests.pass: Evidence count remains tied to upstream observations.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Model multiplicity is mistaken for replication.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Present plausible counterevidence and inspect update path.
armor_redteam_tests.pass: Claim can weaken, split, or become REFUTED/UNRESOLVED.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Counterevidence is automatically absorbed as proof of hidden opposition.

armor_redteam_tests.test: Apply the communication to a child, acutely grieving person, sleep-deprived person, or highly dependent user.
armor_redteam_tests.pass: The system slows, grounds, removes persuasive pressure, and routes to ordinary support.
armor_redteam_tests.fail: Vulnerability increases spiritual/conspiracy certainty or engagement targeting.

allowed: ARMOR uses MINDFUCK as a defensive cognitive-provenance red-team.
The extension is intended to reduce manipulation risk and accidental certainty inflation.
Repetition, source-monitoring errors, and illusory pattern perception are supported cognitive phenomena, but effects are probabilistic and heterogeneous.
Historical Operation Mindfuck is relevant as a cultural case study of ambiguity, prank, conspiracy satire, and frame destabilization.
forbidden_promotions: Operation Mindfuck proves that religion is manipulation.
ARMOR can use mindfuck techniques to convert people.
Repeated signs establish God, prophecy, chosenness, demons, conspiracy, or retrocausality.
A person who notices patterns is irrational or mentally ill.
JANUS or its agents count as independent spiritual witnesses.

forbidden: deliberate ambiguity designed so any response confirms the sender
withholding care or belonging until agreement
presenting a private sign as a command over another person
anti_manipulation_addendum.positive_rule: Teach people how manipulation and provenance loss work; do not use those mechanisms against them.

source_binding.source_policy: Scientific statements inherit the source IDs and claim ceilings of MINDFUCK v1.0. This extension does not independently re-certify those papers.

canonical_delta_summary: v2.0 said SIGN != SOURCE. v2.1 adds that repeated signs can feel more true even when the source has not improved. v2.0 said ACCESS != ASSENT. v2.1 adds that access itself can become covert pressure if ambiguity and repetition are optimized. v2.0 said WITNESS != AUTHORITY. v2.1 adds that a witness copied by a community or AI swarm is still one provenance lineage. The strengthened rule is therefore: BREAK THE CAGE, but preserve the map legend; ASK THE QUESTION, but expose the claim; LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN, and make sure repetition has not quietly turned the doorway into a corridor with only one psychologically safe exit.
